slug: 2025-05-20 LeSwitch expands to localized POS transactions (Central Bank of Lesotho)

facts.fact: LeSwitch introduced instant payments between banks and mobile money (M-Pesa and Khetsi) in 2021, per Standard Lesotho Bank's Samuel Koetle.
LeSwitch, formerly the National Payment Switch, connects banks and mobile money wallets and now carries local ATM and POS debit card transactions, with POS in pilot from 11 May 2025.
Mobile money services M-Pesa and Khetsi are named as connected to LeSwitch for instant payments with banks.
